reason: The patch changes groups_controller.rb `members` so every group defaults to `limit = (params[:limit] || 50)`; before, only automatic groups were limited, to 200. The public group-members.js.es6 route only calls `model.findMembers()`, which sends the model's default limit 50 and offset 0. members.hbs, group.js.es6 and the missing group-members controller/view have no next, previous or load-more control, so the public page can never show members after the 50th.
